## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school trustees as the new teacher. Upon her arrival, she quickly gained the enthusiasm of her students, organizing activities such as field trips and a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag. Although she considered taking a position in her home district, she ultimately decided to return to teach in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for another year.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as Anne's schoolteacher and mentor, guiding her through her schoolwork, field trips, and preparation for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. Their connection extends beyond the classroom into a true friendship, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly anticipating Miss Stacy's instruction and enthusiastically embracing her initiatives, such as a student Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag.

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--stacy.md)
